headline: Australia Q3 inflation accelerates, strengthening case for RBA interest rate hike
summary: Australian consumer price inflation quickened in the third quarter, bolstering expectations that the Reserve Bank of Australia will raise interest rates.
why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets monetary policy to keep inflation within its target range, influencing borrowing costs and the currency.

impacts.name: Australian Dollar
impacts.why: Higher inflation increases expectations of central bank rate hikes, boosting currency yields.

why_moved: Higher-than-expected inflation metrics increase the probability of near-term rate hikes by the central bank.
